name: Documentation Request
about: Request documentation updates or improvements

labels: documentation

---

**Which document(s) need attention?**
`[e.g., rules/api-reference.md / rules/user-manual.md / rules/project-structure.md / README.md]`

**What is missing or incorrect?**
A clear description of the gap, e.g.:
- New public interface not documented
- Directory tree out of date (file added/moved/removed)
- User manual missing a feature or example
- Numbers drifted from reality (test counts, rule counts)

**Expected content**
What should the document say instead?

**Additional context**
Add any other context, screenshots, or references.
